001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhost;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBEchoMovement;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
008
009public class EchoGhost extends BaseSensorGhost {
010
011        public EchoGhost(SensorGhostManager manager, CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
012                super(manager, 0);
013                
014                initEntity(2000f, fleet.getRadius());
015                if (!placeNearPlayer(700f, 1200f)) {
016                        setCreationFailed();
017                        return;
018                }
019                
020                entity.addTag(Tags.UNAFFECTED_BY_SLIPSTREAM);
021                
022                float delay = 0.05f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 0.05f;
023                float duration = 5f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 5f;
024                addBehavior(new GBEchoMovement(fleet, delay, duration));
025        }
026        
027}
